meta.title: Recognise a service PR line from its details

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions list in the buyer portal.
Ensure the search is performed among open purchase requisitions.

args.goal: find an open purchase requisition containing a service line, open the PR number, open that line's Details view, and stop when the screen shows Item Type S or Service, a Material / Service code, an Account Assignment Category, and the service activities with each activity's quantity and unit

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for opening a PR line's details or asserting its service activities, so inspect the buyer-visible details screen directly.
Confirm the details view visibly identifies the line as a service item.
